# Mod config files that are NOT a player's preferences, so `mcopts sync` leaves
# them out: mod internals and compatibility fixes, which follow the pack;
# server, common and worldgen settings, which are the server's or the world's;
# caches and generated files. One pattern per line, matched as a substring of
# the path under the game folder (config/...), case-sensitively. A file that
# matches none is a preference.

mixin

cardinal-components
